test_locate_with_convert_target: test that locate returns the same object after converting it to a string path and back
test_locate_nested_class: test that locate correctly resolves nested classes like A.B using __qualname__
test_locate_builtin: test that locate works with Python builtins like len and dict
test_locate_pytorch: test that locate resolves PyTorch objects like torch.optim.SGD where pydoc.locate fails
test_locate_failure: test that locate raises ImportError when given an invalid string like asdf
